item.title: Laurence Speight: 'Take the disintegration of the biosphere as seriously as Covid-19'
item.description: Why does the steady stream of scientific reports on the rising global temperature, the catastrophic loss of biodiversity, and more, not result in a concerted collective effort to reverse these monumental harms?

item.title: Sydney’s antisemitic attack condemned by DUP at Mid Ulster Council meeting
item.description: Councillor Paul McLean (DUP) has spoken of his party’s sense of shock following the Bondi beach terrorist attack which killed at least 15 people, and injured dozens more, as crowds of Jewish families gathered to celebrate Hanukkah in Sydney on December 14.
